To form the taddhita derivative from the nominal stem **पार्पर** with the affix **छ**:

1. By Pāṇini 7.1.2 (*आयनेयीनीयियः फढखछघां प्रत्ययादीनाम्*), the initial letter **छ्** of the suffix is replaced by **ईय्**, giving the affix **ईय**.
2. The stem **पार्पर** undergoes stem-final elision (*bha-saṃjñā* and *yasyeti ca*, Pāṇini 6.4.148): the final vowel **अ** of **पार्पर** is deleted before the vowel-initial suffix **ईय**.
   $$\text{पार्पर्} + \text{ईय} = \text{पार्परीय}$$
